A while back I made a Pokémon IRC game based on Pokemon Insurgence. Their community is rather small/dead when it comes to IRC and only a few people there even gave the game a chance, so I'm posting this here to gauge interest on the game to see if it is worth continuing development. If there is interest I am thinking about adding more Pokémon mechanics such as EVs/IVs/Nature/Abilities etc and changing the game to be based on ORAS instead of a fan game.

There's really no need for a guide as all the commands are, in my opinion, rather straight forward. You can also just skip to the bottom of this post for a general overview for each command. Just try them out, and you should be able to understand how the game works. If not, you can read this needlessly long tutorial on all the commands and gameplay currently in the game.

About Commands

This part explains how to actually use commands. I didn't think this was needed but apparently it is. The bot uses a few symbols as triggers. These triggers allow the bot to know that it should read your line of text and do something associated with it. There are many different triggers which all preform the same command and are just a different preference on typing the commands. The following are triggers used in this game: "!", ".", "`", and "@". This means the bot will understand "!Commands", but will not understand you just typing commands in the chat. All commands must be the first word of the line.

The @ is a special trigger as it is the only that will broadcast a message to the channel instead of privately noticing you the message instead.

Starting the game

Now that you know how to use a command you can type any trigger and the word "Starter" combined. Example: !Starter. Doing this by itself will return an error message, as will most commands, and will inform you that you need to pick one of the following starters: Bulbasaur, Squirtle, Charmander, or Eevee. This is done by typing !Starter again and adding one of the starter Pokémon to the line. Example: !Starter Bulbasaur.

Exploring

You've received a starter Pokémon, now what? The next step is to "!Explore". This command has two different outcomes depending on chance and your settings.

First outcome

The first outcome is the most likely, you encounter a random wild Pokémon in the location you're currently at, which would be Shade Forest.

It will tell you that a wild Pokémon has appeared, and that you've sent your starter Pokémon out to battle it. The next step is to fight the wild Pokémon. This is done by using the command "!Use", by itself use does nothing as it requires a move to be appended to the line. You can see your current Pokémon's move set by typing "!Stats", which displays other information about your Pokémon as well. Just pick one of the moves and do "!Use Tackle" or something along those lines. *

In this version of the game certain moves do not work, such as status effects, just pick something else.

Continue attacking it until your foe has been knocked out, or you can try and catch the wild Pokémon using "!Throw", but you do not have any at the moment.

To get Poke Balls you have to buy them from the Poke Mart. To use the mart you just type !Mart, which displays it's stock, which at the moment just has Poke Balls. To buy an item you can either type !Buy Poke Ball [#] or !Mart Poke Ball [#], the number being optional, if you do not include a number you will only buy one.

Knocking out or catching a Pokémon awards exp just like in the real game, and any damage suffered during the battle stays.

The Second Outcome

The second outcome is less likely, and that is you will encounter one of the trainers in the area and battle them. The battling is the same as fighting a wild Pokémon. Trainers will be the key to progressing in the game, you need to defeat them all to go to the next area. Defeating a trainer awards money, which allows you to buy stuff from the Poke Mart. Losing any battle makes you lose money, so you should visit the Pokémon Center often, using "!Heal" to keep your Pokémon healthy.

Map System

The game users a linear styled map system. To navigate through out the map a player has to use !Map Next (!Nmap) or !Map Prev (!Pmap). Certain Pokémon are only in certain locations. Players may only use the Mart/Pokémon Center in a town or city. When you blackout you are returned to the map where you last used the Pokémon Center. So you will have to navigate using !Map to get to where you were before you blacked out.

Commands

PokemonBot Game Command Description
!Commands Lists all the commands like this section here, minus the description.
!Starter This is how you start the game.
!Explore The main function of the game and how you level-up and catch Pokémon.
!Battle This allows you to PvP with another person online. Moves must be done within 60 seconds, else you lose.
!Use This is how you use an attack during battle.
!Stats This displays general information about your current leading non-fainted Pokémon.
!Party This displays your current party, this information is limited due to text message restraints
!Forget This is how you make your Pokémon forget a move when it levels up and learns a new move when it already knows four moves.
!Switch This is how you switch Pokémon in battle and outside battle. You can also switch party positions by specifying two Pokémon instead of one.
!PC This displays all your Pokémon in the specified PC box, if no number is specified 1 is defaulted.
!Deposit This deposits the specified Pokémon into the first open box slot
!Withdraw This withdraws the specified Pokémon from the PC if there is room in the party, if not you will have to specify a Pokémon in your party as well.
!Throw This throws the specified Poke Ball.
!Run This allows you to escape from wild battles.
!Map Used to navigate throughout the region. !Map Next (!Nmap) or !Map Prev (!Pmap). Chance of encountering wild Pokémon if there are any present on the map.
!Heal This heals your entire party at the Pokemon Center
!Mart Shows the current stock of items. !Mart <Item> [#] buys the item(s).
!Fish Used for fishing, by default it uses your best rod, specify the rod you want to use if you want to use a lower tier.
!RockSmash Used to Rock Smash a smashable rock in a map. A Pokémon in your party must know a fighting move to smash rocks.
!Surf Used to surf on water to encounter Pokémon. Requires an Instant Lapras.
!FS Enters your friend safari or the one specified if the player has one.
!Card Shows your Trainer Card, lists Pokedex entries, number of badges, money, Poke Balls in bag.

tl;dr Basic overview picture of how a Pokémon game on IRC would work
